name: Camp Merriwood
description_short: Traditional overnight camp for girls ages 8-15 on Upper Baker Pond in Orford, NH, founded in 1949. It offers a 7-week full session, 4-week and 3-week half sessions, and 2-week "Splash of Magic" sessions for new campers in current grades 1-4, with land sports, tennis, waterskiing, gymnastics, riding and the arts.
swim_waterfront_notes: On Upper Baker Pond. All girls take daily swim classes in American Red Cross levels taught by Water Safety Instructors; swimming only at set times in designated areas with lifeguards and a buddy system. Boating, canoeing, sailing, crew and waterskiing are offered.
